adaptations.shared: Existing MLP, Adam, batch-class-balanced CE, task order and 200/class maximum retained. New corrections are borrowed controls, not proposed mechanisms.
adaptations.wa: Mean L2 norm ratio scales latest-task weights and biases after each incremental task; no positive-weight clamp; original base losses retained.
adaptations.bic: Persistent class-introduction holdout never enters feature training or replay; up to20 heldout plus180 training-memory slots per class. Balanced calibration uses min available heldout per seen class; latest-task alpha/beta fitted with frozen model and folded into head before next task. Adam instead of original SGD.
adaptations.ssil: Separated old/new CE and taskwise old KL, with64 additional old replay rows per base batch. Original LwF/RCL/DER++ auxiliary losses retained as an explicit stacked adaptation. Single-class task softmax CE/KL is identically zero. Additional replay exposure recorded.
adaptations.cbf: Post-base equal-count random subset from current data and stored old memory, at most200/class, Adam at0.1x base learning rate; post-base teacher taskwise distillation includes new task; no image augmentation or herding. Extra updates counted separately.
adaptations.development: Seeds5/6 only; stratified10% training holdout for candidate selection, disjoint from all optimization and BiC calibration. Official ID test is never used for selection. Formal1/2/3/4/42 restore original training pool, subject only to BiC internal holdout. Fixed historical base lambdas reused.
